dummyHits.note: 0 hits on a lone dummy. The pulse (Shield_Lancer_Honed_Defenses_obj, isAttack 0, circle r = 112*(1 + p3) px around the player, singleHit, 14 frames) is created only when Buff 105 stacks exist (TalentsShieldLancer L911) and has damage[1] = floor(d_s * n * (1 + m)) with n = stacks consumed, d_s = floor(V1*(1 - p10)*(1 + p1 + RSS21*0.01*p5)), V1 = 3.25L. Stacks come only from the player taking or blocking damage or from Shield Wall hits on an enemy (+1 stack per shield hit, max 20 + p7, 8 s refreshed); the dummy never attacks, so without Shield Wall n = 0 and the cast does nothing. Range (rule 24): a ring around the player - a dummy up to ~124 px away (p3 = 0) gets the single pulse, at the strict 160 px 0 unless p3 >= 3 (reach 112*1.45 + 12 = 174 px). With Shield Wall the engine should model it as deferred damage: every Shield Wall hit on the dummy deposits d_s*(1 + m) (m = p9/p12 bonus, thorns excluded) that is paid out in one pulse per cast, i.e. per cast 1 hit of n*d_s with n = (Shield Wall hits per s) * period, capped at 20 + p7; this per-cast stack count is not a constant, so the standalone base is 0.0. baseProjectiles = 1, perExtraProjectile = 0. p13 Royal Defender summons, p11 Sky Bulwark, p12 (x(1 + 0.18r) and 3 s stun at full stacks) are subskill effects.
